envelopes.anthropic: USD 1, declared on claude-haiku-5-5's first call
envelopes.scaleway: EUR 3, raised from EUR 2 before round 1

exchange_rate.source: European Central Bank euro reference rate, the last published before round 1

notes.gemini-3.5-flash-lite: GEMINI_QUOTA_PROJECT must be set. On the first slot of a Pacific day, if that day is not yet declared, add --gemini-requests-used-today N, N being the count AI Studio shows; never declare a day twice, and declare again if later slots cross Pacific midnight. A replacement does not repeat a declaration.
notes.exchange_rate: The latest ECB reference rate published before round 1: the spec's rate of round 1's date does not exist on a day without one, and the rate must be fixed before the runs. Approved by the maintainer with this manifest.
notes.first_calls: Taken on main before this manifest, so that a first call that changes a configuration comes before its fingerprint is frozen. They take no slot and never count. Approved by the maintainer.
